title: InsightDAO
tagline: Insights on DAO by providing a dashboard of their votings and spent.
description:
This Smart Contract based dApp rids the hassle of tracking different proposals and accounting of a DAO on the user site. It is your one-stop place for having meaningful insights from the DAOs activity.

It works smoothly as soon as you connect your digital wallet to the dApp and let the server load. The contract address the executive body will have the option to delegate or fill in the details of their transactions.

The dApp provides information about DAOs you are a member of and the place where proposals are present for a live vote.

Not only do you gain important information on your DAOs apart from incoming/ outgoing tokens. You also get to know data on the Voting History and Pattern of DAO, Particular activities executed by the DAO team, active proposals of DAOs, and much more.
how_its_made:
Insight DAO is a Smart Contract based dApp that tells you about the DAOs recent activities. Given that your DAOs are decentralized institutions, Insight DAO informs and provides you insights into your digital wallet.

Insight DAO connects to your digital wallet and records all changes happening - incoming and outgoing transactions. It shows you a list of DAOs that you are a part of and the proposals for a live vote.
